model: GNU BF524 with documented deferred D-register patch; not hardware validation
limitations: The complete callback runs unmodified only in its bounded pitch/disabled routes, with other destinations excluded. No complete LFO or module identity is inferred.
Incoming pitch buffer is explicit and generally nonconstant; modifier consumes it. This is not the missing original VoiceCtl-register-to-buffer producer.
The event order and render counter remain explicit. L1 handoff, original clock, ADSR/output and plugin integration are not completed.
Firmware, original instructions, disassembly and private ELF are not distributed.

rea.scope: Static symbol-bounded disassembly only. function command rejects this Blackfin ELF; original instruction evidence and ELF remain private.

validation.windows: New comparator compiled with Windows MSVC target and passed under Wine; native Windows/macOS CI pending.
validation.sanitizers: New comparator passed ASan+UBSan; LeakSanitizer disabled for sandbox ptrace limit.
validation.independent_reproduction: Two new private directories agree byte for byte on expanded inputs, overrides and original output.
validation.adapter_guards: Unsupported last-channel destination or volume target rejected before pitch mutation; inactive kind preserves pitch.
validation.timing: No hardware, DAW/ASIO, latency or dropout measurements.
